description: This file defines the IActivityManager interface in the Android framework, including method declarations for activity and UID observer management, permission checks, and logging.

classes.name: IActivityManager
classes.description: Interface for managing activities and UID observers in Android.

methods.name: registerUidObserver
methods.description: Registers a UID observer for specific events.

methods.name: registerUidObserverForUids
methods.description: Registers a UID observer for multiple UIDs.

methods.name: addUidToObserver
methods.description: Adds a UID to an observer.

methods.name: removeUidFromObserver
methods.description: Removes a UID from an observer.

methods.name: isUidActive
methods.description: Checks if a UID is active.

methods.name: getUidProcessState
methods.description: Retrieves the process state of a UID.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks a specific permission for a process and UID.

methods.name: logFgsApiBegin
methods.description: Logs the beginning of an FGS API call.

methods.name: logFgsApiEnd
methods.description: Logs the end of an FGS API call.

methods.name: logFgsApiStateChanged
methods.description: Logs a change in FGS API state.
